rationale: The description explicitly includes artificial intelligence in a system to detect, locate, and alert police to gunfire, which supports the AI binary.
ai_type_rationale: AI is stated as part of the detection system, but the description also identifies sensors, algorithms, and acoustic or optical sensing without stating that detection depends on AI; ai_enabled is therefore the best-supported subtype, weak and forced.
evidence_spans: An advanced system of sensors, algorithms and artificial intelligence to detect, locate and alert police to gunfire.
ai_type_evidence_spans: An advanced system of sensors, algorithms and artificial intelligence to detect, locate and alert police to gunfire.
using acoustic, optical, or potentially other types of sensors
conflict_response: Both proposals correctly treat the explicit artificial-intelligence mention as a supported binary positive. For subtype, the text establishes inclusion in the core system but not dependence over the named conventional sensors and algorithms; I therefore retain AI while changing the subtype to weak/forced ai_enabled rather than asserting ai_native.
